lesson.title: Expressing Preferences Politely When Checking Into a Hotel

concept.explanation_zh: 在酒店办理入住时，表达个人偏好（如房间类型、楼层、是否吸烟等）时，使用礼貌且自然的表达方式非常重要。这可以帮助工作人员更好地满足你的需求，同时保持良好的沟通氛围。常用表达包括“I would prefer...”，“If possible, could I...”，“Is it possible to...”，这些表达既表达了请求也体现了礼貌。
examples: I would prefer a room on a higher floor, please.
If possible, could I have a non-smoking room?
Is it possible to get a room with a nice view?
concept.common_mistake_zh: 有些学习者直接用命令句，如“Give me a non-smoking room.”这听起来不礼貌。正确表达应加上礼貌用语，比如“I would like...”或“Could I please...”来请求。

vocabulary.pronunciation_tip_zh: 重音在第二个音节，发音时注意清晰的‘fɜr’音
vocabulary.explain_in_english: I say this when I like one thing more than another.
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 正式和非正式场合均可使用，表达个人喜好。
examples: I prefer a room with a view.

vocabulary.pronunciation_tip_zh: 注意‘non’中n和o连读，‘smoking’中的‘smo’重音明显
vocabulary.explain_in_english: This means a hotel room where smoking is not allowed.
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 常用于酒店或公共场所，正式用语。
examples: I'd like a non-smoking room, please.
Do you have any non-smoking rooms available?

vocabulary.explain_in_english: I say this to politely ask for something that might or might not happen.
vocabulary.usage_note_zh: 礼貌表达请求时常用，书面和口语皆适合。
examples: If possible, could I check in early?

scene.title: Checking Into a Hotel and Expressing Room Preferences
scene.context_zh: 在酒店前台办理入住时，客人想礼貌地表达自己对房间的偏好。
scene.script_en:
Guest: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under the name [Your Name].
Receptionist: Welcome! Let me check your booking. Yes, you're all set. Would you prefer a smoking or non-smoking room?
Guest: If possible, could I have a non-smoking room on a higher floor? I usually sleep better when it's quiet.
Receptionist: Absolutely. Let me see which rooms are available on the upper floors.
Guest: Thank you. Also, I would prefer a room with a garden view if that's available.
Receptionist: I found a room on the 7th floor with a nice view of the garden. Does that work for you?
Guest: That sounds perfect. I really appreciate your help.
Receptionist: You're very welcome. Here is your key card. If you need anything else, please feel free to ask.
Guest: Thanks so much. I’m looking forward to my stay here.
scene.translation_zh:
客人：下午好。我有一个以[您的名字]预订的房间。
接待员：欢迎！让我查一下您的预订。是的，一切就绪。您想要吸烟房还是无烟房？
客人：如果可能的话，我想要一间高层的无烟房。我通常在安静的环境下睡得更好。
接待员：当然。我看看高层有哪些空房。
客人：谢谢。另外，如果有的话，我更喜欢一个能看到花园景观的房间。
接待员：我找到了一个7楼的房间，可以看到漂亮的花园。这样可以吗？
客人：听起来很完美。非常感谢您的帮助。
接待员：不客气。这是您的房卡。如果您需要其他帮助，请随时告诉我们。
客人：非常感谢。我很期待这次入住。
scene.practice_tip_zh: 练习时，尝试用不同的偏好词汇（如房间位置、设施等）替换对话中的内容，保持礼貌表达的结构，能帮助你更自然地表达个人需求。

reading.title: A Night at the Cozy Inn
reading.text_en:
Last weekend, I stayed at a small hotel called the Cozy Inn during a short trip. When I arrived, the receptionist greeted me warmly and asked if I had any room preferences. I politely requested a non-smoking room on a higher floor because I sleep better without noise or cigarette smoke. The receptionist quickly checked availability and offered me a quiet room overlooking the garden. I was very happy with the choice and thanked her.
That evening, I settled into the room and noticed how peaceful it was. The quiet view of the green garden helped me relax after a busy day. The hotel also provided a small welcome gift, which made me feel appreciated. I realized that expressing my preferences clearly and politely made the whole check-in process smooth and pleasant.
The next morning, I enjoyed breakfast in the hotel’s dining area. I chatted with other guests and shared my positive experience. One guest even asked how I managed to get such a nice room, and I explained that simply asking politely and being clear about my preferences went a long way.
This stay reminded me that good communication, especially when traveling, can make a big difference. Being polite and specific about what you want helps others help you better. I will definitely remember this for my future trips and recommend it to friends who travel often.
reading.summary_zh: 作者记录了在一家名为Cozy Inn的小酒店入住的经历，强调了礼貌表达个人偏好（如无烟房、高楼层、安静景观）如何让入住过程顺利且愉快。

questions.question: What kind of room did the author request at the hotel?
questions.answer: The author requested a non-smoking room on a higher floor with a garden view.

questions.question: Why does the author think polite communication is important when traveling?
questions.answer: Because being polite and clear about preferences helps make the check-in process smooth and helps staff provide better service.
